notes: Radius divergence: element-count mode is 4px (chips, theme-control buttons, code pills); area mode is 12px; tokens say --card-radius 10px, --button-radius 6px. Cards and figures carry the area.

Home vs cross-page: home is badge/CTA heavy (btn--primary on ink #1a1917); cross-page the dominant interactive color is the lavender accent #5b4bc4 as link text (1746 text uses) and lavender-tint #5b4bc414 backgrounds (theme-control active, chips).

Logo: text wordmark (header a.wordmark "Jack Jin"); no inline SVG, no logo-classed img, no apple-touch-icon. og:image /assets/site-social.png is a social card, not a logo; favicon /favicon.ico saved separately.
Census measured light mode only (no color-scheme emulation); the site ships a Light/Dark/System theme control.
